title: Efficacy of N-Acetylcysteine (NAC) in Preventing COVID-19 From Progressing to Severe Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the efficacy of N-acetylcysteine (NAC) in preventing those with mild or moderate COVID-19 from progressing to severe disease
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* known or suspect COVID-19 disease AND one or more of the following influenza-like symptoms, including: diarrhea vomiting fever (subjective or measured) chills myalgias fatigue sore throat headache cough nasal/sinus congestion or rhinorrhea shortness of breath chest pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* Minors, pregnant women and people unable to provide informed consent are excluded from this study
condition: SARS-Associated Coronavirus as Cause of Disease Classified Elsewhere
